yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No calendar date or year is independently spoken. January 17–20, 1749 comes from YAML; the approach is in daylight, with afternoon, evening and late night subsequently named.
yamlCheck.explanation: The fly-test aside at u0086–u0087 refers to being a couple of days out and to an already completed test, but supplies neither a measured journey nor an unambiguous played rewind. The battle, resurrection and celebration have a same-day sequence; a next-morning planning cue may extend the closing frame by one night. Three date transitions are not independently established. Missing elapsed coverage is not a contradiction; no days are supplied from drEnd.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: The opening is already at the siege approach; the later couple-of-days-out aside may recall earlier travel business without resolving that interval.

alternatives.reading: Covered play begins with the daylight battlefield approach.
Earlier travel/testing business is included retrospectively, but its start and elapsed span remain unspecified.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: The celebration ends late at night; the player’s next-morning cue leads into meta planning.

alternatives.reading: The last resolved event is the late-night celebration; planning supplies no further played advance.
The planning is framed on the following morning, crossing one additional date boundary.
